free_tier.stated: 2 MiB per image, no per-account total; unlimited images per post

retention.stated: 2 MiB hard cap after the 2024 migration off Imgur; images are re-encoded/downscaled, so it is not byte-exact storage; posting rate limits per site | the most permanent image host in this set — SE migrated every historical Imgur URL to i.sstatic.net in May 2024 precisely to guarantee links never rot; a live 2013-era test image still returns 200 with Last-Modified 2024-05-01

egress.terms: free, Cloudflare-fronted, cacheable — probe showed 'Server: cloudflare', 'cf-cache-status: HIT'

tooling: no official image-upload endpoint in the SE API; images are inserted by the web editor or by POSTing a post body containing an already-hosted URL. Wrapper only (Selenium/editor automation) — this is the failure point
chaining: 2 MiB x unlimited posts x unlimited answers x N Stack Exchange sites (180+ sites, one network account). 500 GB = ~256,000 images; not a practical bulk store without a browser farm
limits_note: 2 MiB hard cap after the 2024 migration off Imgur; images are re-encoded/downscaled, so it is not byte-exact storage; posting rate limits per site
